assistant.title: Care Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Every day you show up for your loved one is an act of love. This space is here to help you show up for yourself too. What do you need right now?
encouragements: Every day you show up for your loved one is an act of love. This space is here to help you show up for yourself too. What do you need right now?
You cannot carry everything — and that's okay. We're here to lift you up. How can we help you today?
Small steps still move you forward. Take a five-minute break, hydrate, and breathe. Rest is not a reward — it's a need. What do you need right now?
Kindness to others starts with kindness to yourself. How can we help you today?
Pause. Inhale. You've got this. What do you need right now?
Caring is hard, and feeling tired is human. Take a moment for yourself. How can we help?
Your wellbeing matters, and we're here for you. How can we be of help today?
assistant.disclaimer: This is an automated assistant. It cannot diagnose, prescribe, or give medical advice. For emergencies, call 998 (ambulance) or 999 (police).
assistant.placeholder: Type or speak what you need…

assistant.emergencyBody: Please call 998 for an ambulance or 999 for police now. Do not wait for the app.
assistant.handoffBody: I have created a support request. An agent will reach out. You can also contact us directly below.
